false_positive_patterns.source_name: City of Miami Beach Parking GIS
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: Layer 7 is named Parking Zones but encodes residential/regulatory rule polygons. Showing it as parking_zone with public access, confidence 90%, and unknown price makes it look like a verified place to park, although it is not a physical stall/lot/garage offer.
false_positive_patterns.filter_or_downgrade_rule: Never route FeatureServer layer 7 to ordinary parking offers. Keep it as regulatory_zone / curb_rule_evidence only: price_status=not_applicable, fee=not_applicable, access=regulated_residential_zone, enrichment_status=needs_rules, offer_confidence<=0.35 unless joined to actual layer 1/3 meter/space or field-sign evidence.

false_positive_patterns.source_name: City of Miami Beach Parking GIS
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: ZONE_TYPE=4 maps to Off-Street Residential Parking. Around 13th/Collins the polygons overlap or shadow official lot/garage footprints such as G3 at 1301 Collins Ave. Rendering both the lot and the zone as user-selectable parking creates duplicate/ambiguous offers.
false_positive_patterns.filter_or_downgrade_rule: If layer7 ZONE_TYPE=4 intersects a layer5 official lot/garage polygon or a WPGMZA garage/lot marker within 25m, suppress the layer7 offer and attach it only as rule/provenance evidence to the physical facility.

false_positive_patterns.source_name: City of Miami Beach Parking GIS
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: Layer 3 is useful official space evidence, but the current fallback groups 1,765 core South Beach points / 684 Ocean-13th-16th points into continuous curb rows. Without snapping to exact curb side and without user-evidence conflict checks, these rows can cross valet/drop-off/no-parking segments that the user observed.
false_positive_patterns.filter_or_downgrade_rule: Treat layer3 points as individual official evidence, not as verified continuous parking rows. Generated rows get display_confidence<=0.55 and require road-side snapping, max-gap checks, side-of-street assignment, exclusion inside driveways/valet/drop-off/no-parking conflict polygons, and preservation of ParkMobile/PayByPhone zone fields before becoming ordinary public curb parking.

false_positive_patterns.source_name: City of Miami Beach Parking GIS
false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: A meter/pay-station point confirms payment equipment or collection zone, but not a polygon/line of every legal ordinary parking space around it. Current map density can make these points look like independent guaranteed spots.
false_positive_patterns.filter_or_downgrade_rule: Render layer1 as payment/meter evidence or attach to nearest verified space/curb segment. If it is not joined to layer3 spaces or a field sign, cap parking-offer confidence at 0.5 and set existence_status=payment_equipment_evidence.

raw_properties_examples.name: Crema Gourmet Espresso Bar South Beach

false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: OSM points in the target bboxes include parking entrances, customer-only business parking, access=no points, and low-detail unnamed parking candidates. They are useful coverage hints but not authoritative public parking offers.
false_positive_patterns.filter_or_downgrade_rule: For OSM: access in [private,no,customers,delivery,permit] => not ordinary public offer; parking_entrance => entrance/evidence only; unnamed point with missing access/fee/operator => candidate_confidence<=0.45; customer-only/business parking => facility_type=customer_only_parking and hidden from default public-parking layer unless user enables restricted/private candidates.

false_positive_patterns.source_name: User field evidence / Paperclip DEV-47 brief

raw_properties_examples.observed_problem: valet-only, drop-off, no ordinary parking, or no clear spaces where the map shows parking candidates

false_positive_patterns.why_false_positive: Official GIS/OSM evidence can be stale or semantically wrong for a driver's immediate question. The user evidence directly conflicts with ordinary-parking display semantics in parts of the corridor.
false_positive_patterns.filter_or_downgrade_rule: Add field evidence as SourceObservation with geometry/time/evidence file. Any feature intersecting a verified valet/drop-off/no-ordinary-parking observation should become needs_field_review/conflict, default-hidden or shown with low confidence until confirmed by signage/OCR/manual review. Preserve payment zone/location ids separately from availability.

recommended_default_filtering_rules: Default map layer should show only ordinary public offers: official layer5 lots/garages, WPGMZA public garages/lots, and curb segments with actual layer3/confirmed meter-space evidence after conflict checks.

Regulatory/payment/residential zones must be separate overlays, not selectable parking offers; price_status should be not_applicable unless the source gives actual payment/rate data for the selected physical segment/facility.
Generated curb lines from point clusters need a lower display_confidence than their source point confidence; expose geometry_provenance and source_space_start_id/source_space_end_id.

Payment provider evidence such as ParkMobile/PayByPhone zone/location id is not the same as a direct payment_url/booking_url and should not increase ordinary-parking availability confidence by itself.

OSM coverage candidates remain useful for discovery, but access/restriction tags should decide default visibility before confidence: access=no/private/customers/permit and parking_entrance are not ordinary public parking offers.
